title: Department of Energy manages UFO secrecy and crash retrievals

tellings.quote: think and kind of know that the Department of Energy has a lot to do with managing UFO secrecy and crash retrievals.

plain: The Department of Energy, Michels says, has a lot to do with keeping UFOs secret and with crash retrievals, meaning recovering crashed craft that are not from any known country. He says that he and others "think and kind of know" this, without naming a source. If true, it would put a civilian department, not only the military, at the centre of the secret.
